source.title: Tauberian Operators. Properties, Applications and Open Problems

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH resolver URL. Direct zbMATH page fetching returned blocked_or_challenged 403/Cloudflare behavior, so the official zbMATH API was used for identity recovery. The API identified zbMATH document 6454972 / Zbl 1329.46009 as 'Tauberian Operators. Properties, Applications and Open Problems' by Manuel Gonzalez, published in Concrete Operators, Spectral Theory, Operators in Harmonic Analysis and Approximation, Operator Theory: Advances and Applications 236, pages 231-242 (2014), with DOI 10.1007/978-3-0348-0648-0_14.

No doc_map was constructed because no readable PDF or full HTML primary source artifact was recovered. The Springer DOI landing page and chapter PDF endpoint resolved to no-access preview/paywall HTML rather than the full chapter. The page metadata confirmed Open Access=N, hasAccess=N, Full HTML=N, and only exposed abstract, references, preview, and purchase controls.

Bounded exact-work recovery searched by the exact title, DOI, and title plus PDF. Candidate pages included the Springer chapter/book pages, MaRDI bibliographic metadata, and a ResearchGate result that appeared in search-index text as an author-uploaded full text. These were rejected for extraction because Springer and MaRDI were metadata, preview, or paywalled pages, and the ResearchGate candidate could not be fetched as a readable primary artifact with stable locators in this environment; using search-index text as the technical source would violate the source-adequacy rule.

Moved the run to needs_review under the source-adequacy gate. The recovered materials did not expose a readable exact-work full text with stable page or HTML locators, so extracting questions from resolver metadata, abstracts, preview pages, search snippets, or search-index renderings would violate the evidence-coverage, evidence-completeness, source-adequacy, and no-new-facts requirements.
Saved the exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6454972.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
